repos_data.description: Persistent memory MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Long-term memory via Model Context Protocol with semantic search, Git sync, and team collaboration.
🧠 Persistent memory for AI Agents. Free trial → https://portal.penfield.app/sign-up
Hosted memory for AI agents that learns and forgets — feedback reranks what helps, recall fades by recency. One key across Claude, Cursor, VS Code & ChatGPT. Official MCP Registry.
Persistent memory for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) — past bugs & fixes, decisions, and your corrections, as plain files in your repo.
MCP server and local sync package for Cosmos. Connects agents, iMessage, browser history, calendar, Claude Desktop, and shell history to a shared personal graph.
Your AI forgets everything between sessions. SAME fixes that. Local-first, no API keys, single binary.
Shared memory MCP server for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor). Free & local by default.
AKB — Agent Knowledgebase. Organizational memory for AI agents: vault-scoped docs / tables / files unified by URI graph, served over MCP.

Persistent memory for AI coding agents via MCP — a bitemporal knowledge graph of your codebase, served to Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any MCP client. Tree-sitter + Gemini Flash → Neo4j (via Graphiti). 12 MCP tools, hierarchical clusters, two-regime confidence decay.

Persistent, verified memory for coding agents — so they stop re-explaining your codebase and never act on stale knowledge. Every memory is checked against your actual code; lives in your repo as plain files, shared via git. No account, no DB. Install: npx -y @kage-core/kage-graph-mcp install

CLI + MCP for agent context: a task layer over TickTick, Notion, GitHub, Obsidian & more (RRF retrieval, provenance, reviewed writes, undo) plus a knowledge-graph layer — ats kg: facts from any source, human-ratified. Recommended engines: Graphiti (server), LadybugDB (embedded).
Tentra MCP — memory for AI coding agents. Persistent code graph + AI architecture diagrams. 32 MCP tools. Works in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf.
